title: Web Search Capability
description: The capability to query a web search index and return ranked results with snippets. Defined formally, the network can decide when searching beats answering from memory. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.
inputs_outputs: query string -> ranked results with snippets

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Web Search Capability
demo.program:
# Capability ontology lookup: Web Search Capability
registry = {"web-search": {"inputs_outputs": "query string -> ranked results with snippets", "preconditions": "network access; search API key"}}
q = "web-search"
entry = registry.get(q)
assert entry, "capability not found"
print("capability:", q)
print("  inputs/outputs:", entry["inputs_outputs"])
print("  preconditions:", entry["preconditions"])
print("OK - capability definition resolves in the ontology")
